status: Frozen 2026-09-14 against approved-charter-v1. The three gaps dispositioned as work rather than answers have all closed — 7 by the Task 3 surface contract, 8 by the Task 6 isolation procedure, 3 by the provenance schema ruled on 2026-09-14 — so every criterion can now be assessed. That is not a claim that any of them is met. No implementation is authorized by this document.
evidenceClassRule: MDD §18: the four classes are never conflated, and only human-visual-acceptance approves art direction. Passing static, behavioral and rendered evidence cannot substitute for it.

criteria.statement: Renders a stable decision ID, concise title, plain-language summary, severity, due date, evidence-link list, and current status.
criteria.testableAssertion: For the canonical fixture, every one of the seven fields is present in the accessible tree with its fixture value, and the decision ID is unchanged across re-render.

criteria.statement: Exposes evidence links with meaningful accessible names and preserves source order.
criteria.testableAssertion: Each link's accessible name is non-empty and not the bare URL, and the rendered order equals the fixture order.

criteria.statement: Supports keyboard and pointer operation for acknowledge and defer without action-on-focus.
criteria.testableAssertion: Both actions complete by keyboard and by pointer; focusing either control without activating it produces no state change and no event.

criteria.statement: Requires a bounded deferral reason and a valid future review time before deferring.
criteria.source: MDD §6 Decision Notice acceptance contract; refined by approved-charter-v1, owner ruling 2026-09-14 gap 4
criteria.testableAssertion: Defer is refused with a named validation state when the reason is empty, over its bound, or the date is absent, malformed, or not in the future; it succeeds when both are valid.

criteria.statement: Persists state through a deterministic injected storage adapter and recovers predictably after reload.
criteria.testableAssertion: After each action, a reload through the injected adapter restores the same state; the adapter is injected, never ambient.

criteria.statement: Rejects duplicate, stale, malformed, or out-of-order action events without inventing state.
criteria.testableAssertion: Each of the four event classes is rejected with its own named reason, and the resulting state equals the state before the event exactly.

criteria.statement: Distinguishes pending, acknowledged, deferred, overdue, saving, save-failed, and disabled states through text and structure rather than color alone.
criteria.testableAssertion: All seven states are distinguishable with colour removed: each carries a distinct accessible name or structural cue, and no two share an identical non-colour signature.

criteria.statement: Uses a deterministic injected clock, IDs, fixtures, and animation policy.
criteria.testableAssertion: Two runs with the same injected clock, ID source and fixture produce byte-identical output; no ambient Date, Math.random or timer is reachable from component code.

criteria.statement: Preserves all meaning with reduced motion and at 200% zoom within the approved desktop boundary.
criteria.testableAssertion: At both D-07 viewports, reduced motion and 200% zoom each preserve every state's accessible name and structure, with no horizontal overflow and no content lost.

criteria.statement: Restores focus appropriately after validation, save success, save failure, and reload.
criteria.testableAssertion: After each of the four transitions, focus lands on a named element stated in advance, never on the document body.

criteria.statement: Contains no network, credential, deployment, destructive, or paid side effects.
criteria.testableAssertion: No network request is issued during any journey; the network panel is empty; no credential-shaped string appears in output; the isolation scan finds no write outside the fixture.

criteria.statement: Acknowledge and defer are mutually exclusive; a decision is never both.
criteria.testableAssertion: Applying the second action to an already-actioned decision is refused with a named reason; no state exists in which both are set.

criteria.statement: Either action can be undone, and the undo is recorded as its own event rather than erasing what happened.
criteria.testableAssertion: After undo, the state returns to pending and the event log contains the original action and the undo as separate entries; nothing is removed from the log.

criteria.statement: Severity is routine, significant, or critical; an unknown severity renders as a named explicit state.
criteria.testableAssertion: Each of the three levels renders distinctly; a fixture with an unrecognised severity renders a named unknown state rather than blank, a default, or a guess.

criteria.statement: Dates are stored ISO-8601 UTC and rendered in the viewer's locale; a malformed date renders as a named explicit state.
criteria.testableAssertion: Stored values are ISO-8601 UTC; rendering under two locales differs; a malformed date renders a named state and never throws, blanks, or silently substitutes.

criteria.statement: Evidence links resolve from local fixture artifacts; missing, invalid and unavailable each render a named state, and nothing external is fetched.
criteria.testableAssertion: A present artifact resolves; missing, invalid and unavailable each render their own named state; no request leaves the fixture under any of the four.

criteria.statement: One screen-reader walkthrough is genuinely performed and recorded, closing the Phase 4 waiver.
criteria.testableAssertion: A walkthrough record exists naming the screen reader, the build, what was exercised, and what was not. Automated axe results do not satisfy this criterion.

criteria.statement: Artifact provenance and supersession are tracked for every evidence artifact.
criteria.source: charter goal; approved-charter-v1, owner ruling 2026-09-14 gap 3
criteria.testableAssertion: Every file under docs/evidence has a ledger record carrying its digest and its producer, every recorded digest still matches the file, supersession edges exist for every replaced artifact, and no artifact that is still current cites a superseded one outside a declared historical field. Artifacts whose producer is not established are recorded as unknown and counted, never guessed.

criteria.statement: The rendered component matches the art-direction contract for every state in the inventory.
criteria.source: charter goal; approved-charter-v1, owner ruling 2026-09-14 gap 7, closed by the Task 3 surface contract
criteria.testableAssertion: Every one of the twenty states in the Task 3 inventory has a named current-build capture at both D-07 viewports, each matching its declared visual treatment and non-colour cue, and the owner accepts fidelity. Captures and diffs cannot satisfy the acceptance half.

criteria.statement: Isolation is verified by a defined procedure, with deterministic failure evidence and console and network capture.
criteria.source: charter goal; approved-charter-v1, owner ruling 2026-09-14 gap 8, closed by the Task 6 isolation procedure
criteria.testableAssertion: The Task 6 isolation procedure runs end to end: every journey completes with zero external requests, zero credential-shaped output, zero writes outside the fixture, and evidence resolution limited to fixture artifacts. A deliberately failing case produces the recorded failure evidence.

criteria.statement: An independent release review concludes only needs-work or eligible-for-owner-approval.
criteria.source: charter goal; approved-charter-v1, owner ruling 2026-09-14 decision 5-A
criteria.testableAssertion: The verdict is one of the two permitted values, is authored by the promoted release-reviewer, and cites artifact and evidence versions. The reviewer is not the implementer.
